goal: Establish the current CyberOps infrastructure baseline and identify the technical prerequisites for the November SIEM build, verify host resources, confirm existing VM and network state, identify blockers before installing anything.
definition_of_done: Record available host RAM and disk capacity, identify the relevant VMware VMs and their current resource allocations, confirm the intended Windows endpoint and server roles, establish whether a Wazuh deployment is feasible without unnecessary lab changes.
dependencies: Physical host resource availability, current VMware VM state, access to the existing CyberOps project folder, possible resource constraints from running multiple VMs.
tech_context: Windows host, VMware Workstation, OPNsense 26.7, WIN11-CLIENT01, NS-DC01 running Windows Server 2025, existing LAN and SERVERS subnets, proposed Wazuh SIEM deployment not yet validated.
